# Jared Furtado

> Jared Furtado is an engineering student at Goa College of Engineering in Goa, India, and is still early in learning web development. He has practised with React, Next.js and Node.js through personal learning projects, two client websites (Global Tourist Centre and Techjeeva) and eight hackathons in Goa. He is currently learning DevOps through the 100xDevs cohort. He is interested in entrepreneurship but has not started a venture yet.

Website: https://jaredfurtado.tech/
Email: jaredfurtadowork@gmail.com
Location: Goa, India

## Now
- Learning DevOps through the 100xDevs cohort (https://100xdevs.com/) and applying it to his own projects.
- Interested in entrepreneurship; has not started a venture yet and is learning the business side through client work, a sales internship and events.
- Takes part in hackathons across Goa (see the list below).

## Client work
- [Global Tourist Centre](https://globaltouristcentre.com/): Rebuilt a tourism company's live website in Next.js, with German, French, Russian and Italian versions. Stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, i18n.
- [Techjeeva](https://findfund.vercel.app/): One place to find Indian government funding schemes for startups, filterable by sector and eligibility. Built for FIIRE Forum (Forum for Innovation, Incubation, Research and Entrepreneurship). Stack: React, Tailwind CSS, Google Script API. Source: https://github.com/jjf2009/Techjeeva-

## Learning projects
- [IntentOS](https://github.com/jjf2009/IntentOS): An interface where you describe what you want to get done and it generates a workflow for it, built on Tambo AI's generative UI components. Stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Tambo AI.
- [Ride Buddy](https://github.com/jjf2009/RideBuddy_Forntend): Campus carpooling platform for Goa College of Engineering students with live location, Firebase authentication and route maps. Stack: React, Redux, Firebase, Leaflet.
- [OpenCV Projects](https://github.com/jjf2009/OpenCV_Projects): Real-time computer vision tools — object detection, hand-gesture tracking and face recognition — running locally. Stack: Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, YOLO.
- [Nike Landing Page](https://nike-landing-lac.vercel.app/): Responsive, pixel-accurate landing page clone. Stack: React, Tailwind CSS, Vite.

## Experience
- Freelance web developer, self-employed (Dec 2025 – present): worked on the two client websites above while learning.
- Sales Intern, Avyott, North Goa (Dec 2025 – Jan 2026): B2B outreach for a text AI agent product; generated two qualified leads.
- Event Coordinator, GEC Coders Club, Goa College of Engineering (Jul 2025 – present): runs technical workshops and coding competitions and mentors junior students.
